name: Figs
imageAlt: sliced fresh organic purple figs revealing vibrant seed matrix
description: Figs (Ficus carica) are an ancient, nutrient-dense fruit celebrated for their unique sweet, honey-like profile and complex seed-rich texture. They serve as an outstanding natural gastrointestinal regulator and cellular antioxidant vehicle due to high soluble fiber and polyphenolic content.
macroIntro: Fresh figs offer a high-moisture macronutrient profile centered on naturally occurring monosaccharides and structural plant fibers.
microIntro: Figs provide a mineral-dominant matrix, including key cofactors for enzymatic reactions and vascular health.

microNutrients.name: Potassium
microNutrients.description: Regulates osmotic pressure and vascular tone.

microNutrients.name: Calcium
microNutrients.description: Supports bone mineralization and signal transduction.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B6
microNutrients.description: Facilitates amino acid metabolism and neurotransmitter synthesis.

microNutrients.name: Copper
microNutrients.description: Vital for iron absorption and collagen cross-linking.

healthBenefits: Gastrointestinal Motility: Soluble pectin fiber acts as a prebiotic, optimizing peristalsis.
Vascular Tone: High potassium-to-sodium ratio assists in blood pressure stabilization.
Antioxidant Shielding: Anthocyanins and lutein neutralize free radicals.
Bone Remodeling: Rich source of calcium and magnesium for skeletal integrity.
Proteolytic Efficiency: Ficin assists in the hydrolysis of dietary proteins.
precautions: Sugar Volatility: Dried figs possess significantly higher caloric density.
Mucosal Sensitivity: High ficin activity can irritate oral tissue if consumed in excess.
Oxalate Content: Monitor intake if prone to calcium-oxalate kidney stones.
